question: How does the frozen V713_STOCKLEG_V1 policy (Hydra two-phase flow, confirmed fees) execute the monthly TOP50 targets and AUX liquidations at 200k, measured against the confirmed first-cycle acceptance lines (exec underweight <= 2% of the lot-feasible target; AUX residual cleared)?
scope: Daily-bar auction replay of the stock leg on the frozen Oct-16 monthly targets and V713 states; research only, no production change, no orders
planner: production app.oms.planner (lot_target, session_schedule, plan_sell_session, plan_buy_session) including the STAR min_sell_quantity fix
windows: 114 rolling 12-month windows, each a continuous ledger from cash; cycle 0 of every window is a build from cash

fill_model.sell: closing auction of each sell session: fills at the raw close when close >= limit and the close is not at the down limit
fill_model.buy: opening auction of each buy session: fills at the raw open when open <= limit and the open is not at the up limit
fill_model.capacity: at most 1% of the day's volume per order
fill_model.limits: previous traded close times 10% (main board), 20% (STAR; ChiNext from 2020-08-24) or 5% (ST), rounded half up to the cent
fill_model.corporate_actions: none: the forward-adjusted series already contains dividends and splits
fill_model.suspension: suspendFlag or zero volume blocks the order

metrics: exec underweight and overweight at cycle end vs the frozen lot target
first-session and final buy and sell completion at the signal reference price
unfinished share of NAV by cause
fees per cycle and bps of NAV
AUX residual stock weight at cycle end
12-month window NAV vs the monthly no-fee theory with cash in AUX
sample_unit: cycle; rebalance cycles of overlapping windows repeat calendar months, build cycles are 114 distinct months
qa: archived script and frozen input hashes; every target name has bars; deterministic rerun of the first window
limits: daily bars only: auction price and limit locks are exact, queue priority and auction depth are not; a fill is assumed whenever the price condition holds, up to 1% of daily volume
limit prices are approximated by board and ST flag; IPO days without limits and delisting arrangements are not modelled

dividends are reinvested implicitly through the adjusted series (no tax, no cash timing); absolute prices before later ex-dates are understated, so lot granularity is finer than it really was in older years
no broker rejections, latency, 14:55 cancels or Windows client guards beyond the planner rules
TOP50 names and equal weights are the frozen Oct-16 research targets, selected with the 1M AUM parameters
fees as confirmed on 2026-10-25, not yet checked against a broker statement
stopping_rule: run once; report every cycle kind and both capitals; no parameter change after seeing results
prior_runs: 20261026-01 void (corporate actions inferred from a noisy cached price ratio); 20261026-02 void (QMT dividend records applied on top of forward-adjusted bars, double-counting every dividend and split)
price_basis: market/daily/stocks is forward-adjusted as of its download, not unadjusted: share of closes with more than two decimals 81% in 2016, 48% in 2023, 15% in 2025, 0.6% in 2026. The series is continuous total return, so fills, limit locks and returns are consistent, but absolute price levels (lot sizes, tick rounding) are understated before later ex-dates; cycles from recent_from on are close to raw
